data.long_description:
Binghatti Vintage combines modern design with practical living in one of Majan’s most promising locations. The tower stands out for its architectural clarity and thoughtful planning.

The façade showcases signature Binghatti styling with structured geometry and accent lighting. This design approach gives the building a strong identity within the community.

A wide range of amenities enhances the residential experience, including leisure pools, sports courts, wellness areas, and family-friendly spaces. Everything is designed for everyday comfort.
